content_sections.heading: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Shahdara Vocational Instructor Vacancy 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Vocational Instructor: B.E./B.Tech Electronics & Communication Engineering with at least 50% marks in aggregate. Minimum One Year Experience in a relevant field (innovation, robotics, STEM, AI). Proficiency to teach through Hindi & English. Desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications.

content_sections.heading: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Shahdara Vocational Instructor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Vocational Instructor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Vocational Instructor post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Vocational Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering with at least 50% marks and one year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Vocational Instructor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Shahdara?
faq.answer: The official website is https://shahdara.kvs.ac.in.
